SHARED-F-2-S33.title: Consent Core Logic Service Implementation
SHARED-F-2-S33.description: Implement core consent decisioning logic including two-tier consent evaluation, state transitions (requested, granted, denied), and enforcement rules controlling whether identifiable data can be stored or must be de-identified.

SHARED-F-2-S34.title: Consent Persistence and De-identification Integration
SHARED-F-2-S34.description: Integrate consent decisions with persistence layer and enforce HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification when Tier 2 consent is not granted. Ensure all stored conversation artifacts pass through consent gating.

SHARED-F-2-S35.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
SHARED-F-2-S35.description: Create unit and integration tests validating consent tier enforcement, API responses, and de-identification behavior across workflows including lead capture and unknown question handling.
